purpose: Design of the state models and permitted transitions for ToC publication, ToC build runs, and DLID embedding runs, defining which transitions scripts allow or reject.
summary: Separates published ToC state from build run progress; rebuild-needed and missing-reference are judgments, not states
Confirmed ToC transition table P-01 to P-03 with state diagram (unbuilt or published)
ToC build and rebuild run states B-01 to B-09 from start through scope, IDs, changes, data, references, candidate, finish or failure
Failure keeps the old confirmed ToC, reports failed document, field and reason, and retries only on explicit rerun
Already-confirmed document information is not rolled back when a build fails
Reference check results: match, path mismatch, or missing in directory, with fragment reachability, directory and time; not auto-refreshed
DLID embedding run states E-01 to E-07 including origin confirmation for duplicates and writing only from plan-confirmed state
Search, DLID resolution and checks are stateless and do not change management state
Transition tests cover all permitted transitions, guard failures, undefined events, failure and rerun
tasks: Designing or revising state transitions of ToC build or DLID embedding
Implementing build, rebuild or embed-dlid scripts with transition guards
Deciding failure handling and rerun behavior of builds
Reviewing consistency between requirements and design on states
Handling duplicate DLID origin confirmation flow
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
